bio: First king of the 7 kingdoms. Aegon I Targaryen was born on the second day of the third moon of 30 BC. He is the second born child and first born son of Lord Aerion Targaryen & his sister wife Lady Daenerys Targaryen. Aegon was a rather intelligent child, but very solitary. Aegon was tall and broad-shouldered, with purple eyes and platinum blond hair that he wore short, no longer than the bottom of his ears. He was powerful, handsome in appearance, and very charismatic and commanding. At the age of 15 he started growing a beard. He bonded with Balerion the Black Dread of the five surviving dragons from the doom of Valyria. He was a dragon dreamer. In 14 BC, Lord Aerion died on his dragon's back Aegon was then the new Lord of Dragonstone. In 15 BC, Lady Daenerys decided to betroth him to his elder sister Visenya as per tradition. However their wedding was postponed as war broke between Pentos & Volantis. The war lasted 10 years. During this time a lot of wedding proposals were made to Visenya & Rhaenys. Daenerys considered marrying Rhaenys to the Storm King's son but she categorically refused. When Aegon came back the Storm King proposed a wedding between his daughter Argella & him in exchange of lands. But he also refused and instead offered his close friend and rumored bastard half-brother, Orys Baratheon, as Argella's husband instead, in return for all the lands surrounding the Blackwater Bay, including those possessed by Argilac. Insulted, Argilac cut off the hands of Aegon's envoy and sent those back to Dragonstone. Aegon started plotting for revenge. One cold night
